description: This plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU scores and Average Lagging (AL) for four different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and features a linear scale with numeric tick marks ranging from 2.5 to 10.0 at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and uses a linear scale with numeric tick marks ranging from 25 to 33 at intervals of 1, accompanied by horizontal dashed grid lines. The plot contains four lines, all demonstrating an upward trend as the x-axis values increase. The "Consistency-CE" line is represented by a light purple dashed line with circular markers, starting at approximately x=2.5, y=25.8 and rising steadily to end at x=11.2, y=31.4. The "Inconsistency-CE" line is a dark purple dashed line with square markers, beginning at roughly x=2.4, y=26.1, passing through x=6.4, y=29.9, and increasing to end at x=11.2, y=31.4. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" line is a blue dashed line with square markers, starting at x=2.0, y=26.2, rising through an intermediate point at x=6.3, y=30.2, and concluding at x=11.2, y=31.8. Finally, a fourth line, whose legend label is obscured by a gray rectangle, is depicted as a solid red line with star markers; it begins at x=3.2, y=28.9, rises through points such as x=7.4, y=31.2, and ends at the highest plotted value of x=11.3, y=32.1.
